name: Do rental remodels in the Denver area need to meet specific building codes?

mainEntity.name: Do rental remodels in the Denver area need to meet specific building codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, remodeling an older rental in Denver, Centennial, or Parker often requires code upgrades, especially if you modify plumbing, electrical, or structural framing. Homes built before the 1980s frequently need updated GFCI outlets in kitchens and baths, modernized circuit capacity, and proper moisture barriers behind shower tile. When HH Remodeling performs extensive rental rehabs or basement conversions, Abraham Becerra coordinates certified trade partners to ensure electrical and plumbing work meets regional building safety standards, protecting your asset from future liability and inspection delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, modifying electrical, plumbing, or structural walls requires meeting local safety codes, which our team coordinates with licensed sub-trades.
